answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting. Each identity's interaction graph, timing patterns and resource choices are hashed into a behavioural fingerprint per epoch; continuity requires the new fingerprint to fall within a bounded distance of the prior one, enforced like a drifting ocean current that tolerates slow change but not sudden jumps. A sybil farm must run each fake identity through many epochs, sustaining distinct, coherent histories on a mesa of consistent behaviour. A sparrow-sized budget of variation is allowed; anything larger resets trust.
